title: Reversal Tenure Allowance — Points Kept Back by Long-Enrolled Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus Members
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** On a points reversal after a grooming pass is cancelled and refunded, a reversal tenure allowance is kept back from the reversal, according to the tier held and the full calendar months the membership has been enrolled, counted from its enrollment date.

**Rule.** A membership on a paid tier and enrolled for at least 60 months keeps 40 points. A membership that does not meet both of those conditions but holds a paid tier or Pals Rewards VIP and is enrolled for at least 24 months keeps 20 points. Any other membership keeps none.

| Tier held | Months enrolled | Points kept back |
|---|---|---|
| Tailwise Plus Monthly, Tailwise Plus Annual or Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | 60 or more | 40 |
| Tailwise Plus Monthly, Tailwise Plus Annual or Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | 24 to 59 | 20 |
| Pals Rewards VIP | 24 or more (including 60 or more) | 20 |
| Pals Rewards Member or Pals Rewards Insider | any | none |
| any tier | fewer than 24 | none |
